verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document inbound-message gating for messaging surfaces. There are no sender allowlists, DM policies, or mention gating for external chat channels. The RBAC 'Pending' role controls approval of web UI accounts, which is an adjacent access control rather than gating of inbound messages. Webhooks that post external messages into channels describe an integration path, not a sender-approval policy.

support.subject: As a self-hoster, inbound messages are gated — sender allowlists, DM policies, mention gating — so only people I approve can drive my assistant
